name: Isaac
summary: Isaac is a referral from David who reached out about recovering a banned/disabled Instagram account (@isaacondonesyt, email isaacmadeitwerk@gmail.com). Derrek reviewed screenshots of the ban reason and said it's currently the only unban type going through, since Meta lost Rep Tools after a lawsuit and this reason still has a support-rep method. He quoted $2,700 with a 1-7 day turnaround; Isaac questioned the price and the conversation trailed off without payment or agreement. Follow up to see if he still wants the unban at that price.
key_facts: Quoted $2,700, 1-7 day turnaround for the IG unban
Reacted with sticker shock at the price ('For what?'); no payment made, deal not closed
Derrek's pitch: Meta lost Rep Tools after a lawsuit, so this is the only ban reason still unbannable via a support-rep method
